jobs.title: Unarmed Security Supervisor Job at Triple Canopy in Houston
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY
The Supervisor is responsible for overseeing security officers and ensuring security officers provide routine patrol and access control functions, including property control.
As directed, plans, schedules, assigns, reviews, and supervises field or office operations on an assigned shift; supervises, coordinates, and performs a full range of investigations, patrol, traffic, and/or administrative duties; maintains a good working relationship with the client.
This position works day and night shifts and services AWS locations in Huston and Austin, TX.
